note: Contract shared by tools/texgen/bld_a.py (paints) and tools/blender/bld_a.py (models). Rects are [x, y, w, h] from the image's top-left (Blender v = 1 - y / h). Strips span the full width and tile along U only; decals are unique. The game lights the street with one flat ambient light and ignores vertex colour, so every texture bakes its own form: recess and cornice shadows, darker roofs and undersides, and a darker '_shade' variant for the side faces (camera face = lit).
palette_hint: Match public/textures/map/building1..4.png in value (mid, slightly warm, photo-ish, soft grime) but push the rich tier to dictator kitsch: cream and pink marble (RGB ~ 225,200,185 / 215,170,165), gilt (RGB ~ 205,160,60 with 250,215,120 highlights and 120,80,25 shadows), banner red (RGB ~ 170,25,25), gold-mirror glass (RGB ~ 175,140,70 with paler reflection streaks). Mid values: nothing above ~245 or below ~20.

bld_a_rich_trim.look: Shared rich-tier ornament sheet. Alpha is 255 everywhere except the balustrade strip's gaps. The IDE entry flags it transparent (alpha-tested at 0.5, double-sided).

column.look: One column face, mapped once per face over the column height (7-13 units). Top 14 px gilt Corinthian capital (acanthus lumps, volutes at the corners, abacus 2 px), bottom 8 px gilt base with a torus. Shaft: pink-white marble with 3 vertical flutes (1 px darker lines), cylindrical shading baked (edges 25 % darker, centre lighter), faint grey veins.

banner.look: Tall hanging banner, mapped once per banner quad (aspect 1:3). Deep red cloth with soft vertical folds, 2 px gold border and a 4 px gold fringe at the bottom; top 6 px gold rod band. In the upper middle a gold-ringed medallion (about 24 px) holding the leader's silhouette: a moustached head and shoulders in a peaked cap, three-quarter profile, near-black on cream. A small gold star below it.

door.look: Grand entrance, mapped once: a round-arched marble surround (3 px) with a gold keystone, gilt double doors with raised panels and a bright gold vertical seam, a dark fanlight in the arch head, a 3 px red-carpet threshold at the bottom.

gilt.look: Gilt dome / spire panel, mapped once per dome segment column (u across one segment, v rim (bottom) to apex (top)). 3 px raised rib at the left and right edges (bright highlight on the rib, dark line beside it), the panel between in warm gold with a broad soft highlight band at 40 % height and darker toward the rim (occlusion). Fish-scale relief rows faintly across the panel.

canopy.look: Red-carpet canopy: red cloth top with a 3 px gold border, the bottom 8 px a gold scalloped valance with fringe. Top part maps the canopy roof, the valance part its edges.

flag.look: Red flag with a gold five-point star in a laurel ring at the hoist side, soft folds.

marble.look: Pale pink-white marble paving with large square slabs (12 px), grey-pink veins, a 2 px darker border all round (parapet shadow). Stretched over roofs, terraces and slab tops.

cornice.look: Gilt cornice band: 2 px light gold lip on top, a row of dark dentils (2 px wide, 2 px gaps), egg-and-dart in gold below, the bottom 2 px dark (the shadow it casts). Tiles along U.

rail.look: Gilt balustrade, alpha-cut: 2 px top rail, 1 px bottom rail, vase balusters every 8 px with transparent gaps between. Tiles along U.

carpet.look: Red carpet runner along U: crimson pile, 1 px gold line 1 px in from each edge.

env_bld_apartment_rich_facade.look: Luxury tower facade strips. Lit = the camera (-Y) face, shade = the road (+X) face, 18 % darker and a touch cooler.

tower_lit.look: One tower storey (5 units), 4 bays of 32 px (5 units). Top 6 px: pink marble spandrel, darkened toward the top (the balcony slab above shades it). Rows 6-27: floor-to-ceiling gold-mirror glass, warm gold with pale diagonal reflection streaks, dark 1 px mullions every 8 px and a transom at row 12; 3 px gilt pilasters at the bay joins. Rows 27-32: marble sill band where the balcony slab sits.

podium_lit.look: Double-height marble lobby storey (7 units) behind the colonnade, 4 bays of 32 px (6 units). Pink-white rusticated marble (2 px grooves every 5 px), a tall round-arched window per bay (14 px wide, warm lit interior with a chandelier glint, gold frame), gold keystone. Top 4 px shaded (the entablature over the colonnade casts it), bottom 2 px darker plinth.

env_bld_civic_rich_facade.look: Palace wall, full height of the main block (17 units) in one strip. Lit = the -Y faces, shade = the +X / -X faces.

wall_lit.look: 8 bays of 16 px (4 units). Bottom 18 px rusticated ground floor (pink-grey stone, deep grooves) with round-arched dark openings; then two storeys of tall gold-framed windows on cream-pink marble, the first-floor windows with alternating triangular and segmental pediments in gold; gold pilaster strips between bays; top 6 px a cornice with a dark shadow line under it.

env_bld_civic_rich_parts.look: Palace parts: dome drum, stairs, attic band, pediment, roof.

drum.look: Drum under the dome: cream marble, 8 tall arched windows (dark, gold frames) with paired gold pilasters between them, a gold cornice in the top 4 px, a dark plinth in the bottom 3 px.

stair.look: Rows 0-9: step tread, pale worn marble, lighter toward the front edge. Rows 10-15: riser, shaded marble (the step above shadows it).

attic.look: Attic band above the cornice: cream marble with gilt relief panels (laurel wreaths with a star) between short pilasters, a gold coping line on top, darker at the bottom where it meets the cornice.

tympanum.look: Pediment triangle, mapped once (u across the base, v up to the apex): pink marble field, gold sunburst rays fanning up from the bottom centre, a gilt laurel-ringed medallion with the leader's silhouette in the middle, 3 px gold raking cornice along both slopes.

roof.look: Palace roof, stretched over flat roofs: pale green-grey copper sheet with standing seams every 6 px, darker 3 px border (parapet shadow), faint verdigris streaks.

Back (+Y) and +X faces open, like the poor shell.

env_bld_civic_rich.envelope: Footprint x -26..26, y -16..16; street line y = -15.25 (stairs), x = +-24.49 (pavilions). Main block x -17..17, y -9..15.25, 17 high. End pavilions x +-17..24.49, y -12.5..15.25, 20 high with gilt cupolas.
